purpose: Teach: 山積み/二日酔い/きもの/スライス/話しかける/掴み/じゃー/鍵盤

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、宿題、山積みなんだよ、本気で、絶対、頑張らないと、絶対、本気で、約束
lines.en: Mom — my homework is piling up. I'm serious. I have to try really hard. I promise.
lines.style: Urgent, stacking urgency with each clause. Breathless, as if listing things before they slip away. Small voice fighting to sound mature and dependable. Slight squeeze of worry underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、本気で、絶対、二日酔いで、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、辛そうよね、翔くん、絶対、優しくしてあげようね、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. Your dad looks a bit rough with his hangover, doesn't he? Sho, let's be gentle with him, okay? Really gentle.
lines.style: Soft, almost thinking aloud. Warm redirect without any edge. Quiet warmth — the voice of someone noticing what's happening and gently steering a small person toward kindness. No performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、きもの、絶対、お正月に、絶対、着せてくれるって、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Grandma said she's going to let me wear a kimono on New Year's. I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Bright spike of joy. Quick tempo, almost bouncing in the words. Small child's genuine excitement — not performing, just radiating. The vowels open with pleasure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: パン、本気で、絶対、スライス、絶対、薄めに、絶対、切ってあげるね、翔くん
lines.en: I'll slice the bread nice and thin for you, Sho.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact care. No flourish. The voice of someone doing something small and doing it right. Slight warmth, but the focus is on the task — the care lives in the doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、話しかけるの、絶対、楽しいんだ
lines.en: My friend has been really fun to talk to lately.
lines.style: Open and bright. The simple joy of noticing something good. Quick, unguarded. A small person surprised by discovering that connection feels nice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 人生、本気で、絶対、いいチャンスを、絶対、掴みなさいね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: Life will give you good chances, Sho. When they come, grab them. I promise you.
lines.style: Shift to something heavier, more intentional. A mother passing something on. Quiet conviction — not lecturing, but serious. The words settle. A pause before the final promise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃーね、ママ、本気で、絶対、行ってきます
lines.en: Okay Mom, I'm heading out now.
lines.style: Cheerful farewell rush. Quick, light, the buoyancy of a child leaving the house with things to do. No drag or hesitation — momentum forward.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、ピアノの鍵盤、絶対、よく、本気で、弾いてたって、聞いたわよ
lines.en: You know, when your dad was young, I heard he used to play the piano all the time.
lines.style: Soft, reflective — almost to herself. Warm remembering. The voice of someone sitting with a quiet observation. Gentle nostalgia, no sadness. She's noticing something tender about the past and sharing it gently.
